participant_id.Description: Unique participant identifier corresponding to the subject label used in the BIDS dataset.

birthdate.Description: Participant-reported date of birth. Dates have been anonymized using a participant-specific date shift.

education.Description: Number of years of education completed after obtaining a high school diploma. Education undertaken during high school is excluded.

handedness_write.Description: Hand reported as used for writing or drawing.

handedness_throw.Description: Hand reported as used for throwing a ball.

handedness_brush.Description: Hand reported as used for holding a toothbrush.
